bull.b: The observed 46% response rate, favorable tolerability, and supportive FDA feedback provide a meaningful clinical and regulatory foundation for rezatapopt. Completing enrollment and planning an NDA could advance the company toward commercialization over the next several quarters.

Additional capital gives PMV the ability to fund late-stage clinical work, regulatory submission, and commercialization preparation without an immediate financing requirement. A runway extending into Q1 2028 supports execution of pivotal milestones and preserves strategic flexibility.

Very low leverage limits interest and repayment burdens while the company remains in development. This conservative capital structure provides greater flexibility to direct available resources toward clinical development and regulatory activities rather than debt service.

bear.b: PMV remains entirely dependent on research progress and future financing because it has no commercial revenue to offset its operating costs. Persistent losses make profitability contingent on successful development, regulatory approval, and eventual market adoption.

Sustained negative operating and free cash flow indicate that PMV cannot currently fund its activities internally. Continued development therefore requires external capital or a future commercial launch, increasing dependence on financing execution and clinical milestones.

Funding through new shares and warrant-linked securities can dilute existing ownership as the company finances late-stage development. This reflects the capital intensity of PMV's path to commercialization and may remain relevant while operating cash flow stays negative.
